# The oracle matrix of the script entrances.
# `tools/script-matrix.py` writes this file. Do not edit it.
@@@ case reader-sources reader
--- script
function Reader(input, opts)
  local parts = {}
  for _, s in ipairs(input) do parts[#parts + 1] = s.name .. '=' .. s.text end
  return pandoc.Pandoc({pandoc.Para(tostring(input)), pandoc.Para(table.concat(parts, '|')),
    pandoc.Para(table.concat({tostring(opts.columns), tostring(FORMAT), #input, type(input),
      pandoc.utils.type(input), tostring(PANDOC_SCRIPT_FILE), pandoc.utils.type(opts)}, ' '))})
end
--- input
one
two
@@@ case reader-markdown reader
--- script
function Reader(input) return pandoc.read(tostring(input), 'markdown') end
--- input
# Title

*a* and "b"
@@@ case reader-bytes reader
--- script
function ByteStringReader(input, opts) return pandoc.Pandoc{pandoc.Para(type(input) .. ' ' .. #input .. ' ' .. pandoc.utils.type(opts))} end
--- input
one
two
@@@ case reader-both reader
--- script
function Reader() return pandoc.Pandoc{pandoc.Para'text'} end
function ByteStringReader() return pandoc.Pandoc{pandoc.Para'bytes'} end
--- input
x
@@@ case reader-none reader
--- script
x = 1
--- input
x
@@@ case reader-reader-table reader
--- script

--- input

--- input

@@@ case reader-globals reader
--- script
function Reader() return pandoc.Pandoc{pandoc.Para(table.concat({type(PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS), type(PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS), type(PANDOC_STATE), tostring(FORMAT), type(pandoc.read)}, ' '))} end

@@@ case writer-basic writer
--- script
function Writer(doc, opts) return 'w:' .. #doc.blocks .. ' ' .. tostring(FORMAT) .. ' ' .. pandoc.utils.type(opts) .. ' ' .. pandoc.utils.stringify(doc) end
--- input
[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "Head"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"],BulletList [[Plain [Str "c"]]]]

@@@ case writer-globals writer
--- script
function Writer() return table.concat({type(PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS), type(PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS), tostring(PANDOC_DOCUMENT), type(PANDOC_STATE), tostring(FORMAT)}, ' ') end

@@@ case writer-classic writer
--- script
Para = function(text) return '[' .. text .. ']' end
Str = function(text) return text:upper() end
Space = function() return '_' end
Blocksep = function() return '\n' end
Doc = function(body) return body end
--- input
[Para [Str "a",Space,Str "b"]]
@@@ case lua-arguments lua b c-d
--- script
local out = {}
for i = -1, #arg do out[#out + 1] = i .. '=' .. (i == 1 and 'OUT' or tostring(arg[i])) end
local rest = table.pack(...)
out[#out + 1] = rest.n .. ' ' .. tostring(rest[2]) .. ' ' .. tostring(rest[3])
local f = io.open(arg[1], 'w') f:write(table.concat(out, '\n'), '\n') f:close()
--- input

--- input
